heading: Tatami workflow plugin (`judo-tatami-workflow-maven-plugin`)
proposed: useCache is effectively false when the POM does not set it: the @Parameter default (false) overrides the field initialiser (true) in the ESM and PSM mojos. Set <useCache>true</useCache> to enable caching.
note: Checked in judo-ng-read wt. Maven applies the annotation default when the parameter is absent.

heading: Tatami workflow plugin (`judo-tatami-workflow-maven-plugin`)
proposed: When an archive model cannot be read, the build reports a NullPointerException instead of the read error. Check the archive path and mvn: coordinates first.
note: Checked in judo-ng-read wt.

heading: Tatami workflow plugin (`judo-tatami-workflow-maven-plugin`)
proposed: When <asm> is set and ignorePsm2AsmTrace keeps its default (true), the mojo calls getArtifact(null) and fails with a NullPointerException unless <psm2AsmTrace> is also set. Set <psm2AsmTrace> to the ASM trace artifact.
note: Checked in judo-ng-read wt (develop-era checkout).

heading: Tatami workflow plugin (`judo-tatami-workflow-maven-plugin`)
proposed: When <measure> is set and ignorePsm2MeasureTrace keeps its default (true), set <psm2MeasureTrace> or the mojo fails with a NullPointerException.
note: Checked in judo-ng-read wt.

heading: Tatami workflow plugin (`judo-tatami-workflow-maven-plugin`)
proposed: <destination> has no default, but the mojo creates it whenever saveModels (default true) is on. Set <destination> explicitly, for example ${project.basedir}/target/model, or the build fails with a NullPointerException.
note: Checked in judo-ng-read wt.

heading: Tatami workflow plugin (`judo-tatami-workflow-maven-plugin`)
proposed: Without a generator class and method, the ESM mojo needs <esmModelFile>. If neither is set, the build fails with a NullPointerException.
note: Checked in judo-ng-read wt.

heading: Tatami workflow plugin (`judo-tatami-workflow-maven-plugin`)
proposed: On the IllegalStateException path the ESM mojo saves the model inside a try block with an empty catch, so a failed save is silent and model files can be missing without an error. Check the destination after a failed build.
note: Read from the judo-ng finding; the path was not re-read.

heading: Tatami workflow plugin (`judo-tatami-workflow-maven-plugin`)
proposed: Same as the ESM case: without a generator, the PSM mojo needs <psmModelFile>; otherwise it fails with a NullPointerException.
note: Checked in judo-ng-read wt.

heading: RDBMS naming prefixes
proposed: With an empty column prefix, user attributes named id, type or version would clash with system columns, so they are written as DOMAIN_ID, DOMAIN_TYPE and DOMAIN_VERSION. With the default prefix C_ no clash occurs.
note: Covered-by row U0809 exists; the catalog does not describe the empty-prefix case.

heading: Realm and client generation from the model
proposed: The realm annotation value is added to the realm list untrimmed, but client generation looks the realm up trimmed. A realm value with leading or trailing spaces yields no client under that realm. Write the realm name without surrounding spaces.
note: Read from the judo-ng finding; not re-run.

note: Duplicate root cause of R0072.

heading: Annotations and RDBMS tailoring
proposed: The cascade value in the relation-shape rules spreadsheet is read from the model target, so the spreadsheet cascade column has no effect. Set the cascade behaviour on the ESM relation instead.

note: Read from the judo-ng finding; not re-run.

heading: Transformation Mode and Generation Switches
proposed: The two engines disagree on the NOT NULL flag of junction foreign keys. ZETA marks them NOT NULL when the relation lower bound is above 0; ETL only when lower and upper bounds are both 1. Compare the generated junction tables when you switch engines.
note: Read from the judo-ng finding; not re-run.

proposed: A <Entity> attribute typed as PasswordType gets no data type in the generated ASM under the Zeta engine (no Zeta rule), and the ETL engine stops with "not supported yet". Check the generated ASM after adding a PasswordType attribute.
note: Not reproduced. Verify on develop that a PasswordType attribute really fails before applying.

heading: JSL model workflow (`judo-tatami-jsl-workflow-maven-plugin`, goal `default-model-workflow`)
proposed: When several dialects run in one build, the Liquibase step takes whichever Liquibase model is already in the context, not the model for the current dialect, so one dialect may be built on another dialect's model. Check each dialect changelog after a multi-dialect build (dialects default to postgresql,hsqldb).
note: Code read in judo-ng-read wt: getByClass has no dialect key. Whether a multi-dialect run reuses the context is not verified.

heading: Review Workflow for Incremental Migrations
proposed: Backup table names in the incremental migration are built by plain truncation, which differs from the abbreviated name the full path uses. For long table names, check the backup names in the migration script before running it.
note: Read from the judo-ng finding; not re-run.

heading: Review Workflow for Incremental Migrations
proposed: The incremental Zeta path compares the previous model with itself, so constraints on new elements (foreign keys, unique, index, not-null) are dropped and re-added without a real comparison. Review the incremental changelog before applying it.
note: Read from the judo-ng finding; the claim that the incremental path is the one used by migrations is not verified.

category: internal transformation or OSGi bookkeeping; no visible app output

heading: Review Workflow for Incremental Migrations
proposed: In the incremental Zeta path the container checks return true for any element with a container, so constraints on new elements are treated as existing. Review the incremental changelog for missing constraints on new fields.
note: Read from the judo-ng finding; not re-run.

heading: Review Workflow for Incremental Migrations
proposed: A unique constraint with several fields produces one DropUniqueConstraint per field, each naming the same constraint. Expect repeated drop statements in the incremental changelog.
note: Read from the judo-ng finding; not re-run.

heading: Review Workflow for Incremental Migrations
proposed: The incremental DbCheckup step emits a TableExists precondition for every table, including tables the same migration creates. Review the precondition list before applying the changelog.
note: Read from the judo-ng finding; not re-run.
